items.text:
Change the following sentences as directed in brackets without changing their meaning.
(a) Truthfulness is the greatest of all virtues in a man. (Comparative)
(b) It brings peace of mind. (Interrogative)
(c) Everybody respects a truthful person. (Negative)
(d) Who does not love a truthful person? (Passive)
(e) How peaceful life becomes when you follow truthfulness! (Assertive)
items.explanation:
Suggested answers:
(a) Truthfulness is greater than any other virtue in a man.
(b) Does it not bring peace of mind?
(c) There is nobody who does not respect a truthful person.
(d) By whom is a truthful person not loved?
(e) Life becomes very peaceful when you follow truthfulness.

items.explanation:
Suggested answers:
(a) A chart was prepared by the class.
(b) How useful the chart is!
(c) This chart is the largest chart in the room.
(d) The pupils never refuse to share their materials.
(e) Didn't the teacher display the chart?

(b) I wish that you may have a safe journey. (Optative)
(c) What a wonderful opportunity this is! (Assertive)
(d) Everyone should respect the elderly. (Imperative, beginning with Let us)
(e) The organisers gave the guests a warm welcome. (Passive)
